item.text: The scoped baseline confirms two concrete clusters: nested arrays-of-tables fail because the resolver treats an existing array as a conflict, and lowercase RFC 3339 separators fail. I’m adding explicit table lifecycle tracking plus “latest array element” resolution, and a strict datetime parser that normalizes separators/offsets and truncates fractional seconds to nanoseconds.
